title: Launching Win Back Campaigns: How to Reactivate Lost Customers.

facts.fact: The page was published on June 13, 2025 and last updated on August 10, 2026.
The page cites Marketing Metrics as putting the probability of selling to a lost customer again at 20%-40%.
facts.quote: Marketing Metrics puts the probability of selling to a lost customer again at 20%–40%

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that a cold prospect yields a 5-20% chance of a sale.
facts.quote: streets ahead of the 5-20% you can expect from a cold prospect

facts.fact: The page states that around 47% of reactivated customers go on to spend more than they did before they left, without naming a source.
facts.quote: Around 47% of reactivated customers go on to spend more than they did before they left.

facts.fact: The page says JD Gyms was trading from 30 sites before the COVID lockdowns in early 2020.
facts.quote: JD Gyms were trading from 30 sites and building real momentum.

facts.fact: The page says JD Gyms automatically froze member payments during the COVID-19 lockdowns so members did not have to cancel.
facts.quote: They froze payments automatically, so nobody had to cancel anything to stop being charged.
